A '''transport''' carrying [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] from the [[Mandalorian Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture, crash-landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. The refugees, among them a number of wealthy businessmen, colonized the planet when they were unable to escape Makeb's unique [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].
